format.note: Fields are meaningful, activation matches the stated consumption/reversal scope, examples are concrete, and semantic operation detection is honestly labeled llm_judged. The then clause expresses one end-to-end allocation-preserving reversal obligation. Mechanical checks pass.

generality.note: The rule and examples apply across attributed balances, inventory, and other multi-entry consumption domains; they do not prescribe a particular application feature.

decisionUseful.note: Coder-facing guidance specifies allocation capture, original-entry restoration, injected-clock validity checks, forfeiture reporting, idempotency, and critical-section discipline with concrete implementation and avoidance guidance.

contradictions: The verifier says inserting a new entry is a violation 'unless the original entry no longer exists by design and policy says to forfeit'. As written, this exempts a new-entry restoration precisely when policy requires forfeiture; the specification never permits replacement credits.
extraObligations: Evidence requires allocations to be persisted 'in the same write' as the consuming operation. The specification requires storage with that operation at consumption time, not a single physical write; separate related writes in an atomic transaction can satisfy it.

The verifier requires a reversed marker/status and a second call returning the prior outcome. The specification requires idempotent restoration under the same critical-section discipline, not a particular marker mechanism or repeat-call return contract.

requiredFixes: Remove the verifier exception for inserting replacement entries. State separately that missing original entries are forfeited when policy requires, without creating replacement credits.
Replace the mandatory same-write evidence with evidence of durable allocation capture associated with the operation at consumption time; allow transactional related records.

Make stored-outcome replay and reversed markers examples rather than mandatory verifier requirements; verify exactly-once restoration and the specified critical-section discipline without imposing a repeat-call return contract.
summary: The convention is general, concrete, leakage-free, and carries all specified knowledge. It needs revision because its verifier introduces a contradictory replacement-entry exception and mandates implementation and return-contract details beyond the specification.
